original_test_intent: Validate TEMP_UBB_HSC0 through TEMP_UBB_HSC7 as eight UBB hot-swap-controller temperature channels with correct controller, power-segment and sensing-point identity, consistently reported through complete IB/OOB SDR, Sensor List and BMC Web views.
original_method: The UBB/power owner maps HSC0–HSC7 to fitted controller devices, power segments and sensor locations and supplies condition-specific limits; automation performs passive complete collection and cross-view comparison.
manual_activity: The UBB power/thermal owner identifies every HSC controller and served power segment, defines sensing-point semantics and approves the operating envelope and Web mapping. No power or cooling transition is authorized.
required_inputs: UBB assembly/revision and HSC0–HSC7 fitted population
Per-index controller part/serial, physical position and served GPU/rail/load segment
Measurement source as controller die, board probe, ambient proxy or derived telemetry
Exact SDR entity/name/description and Sensor List/Web mapping for all eight members
Units, scaling, resolution, tolerance, sampling/freshness and unavailable semantics
Approved ranges and thresholds by input voltage, segment load, redundancy, cooling and ambient state
Same-target IB/OOB identity and BMC/SDR/UBB/HSC specification revisions
Secret-safe complete collectors and independent power/thermal/BMC recovery
safety_requirements: Enumerate HSC0 through HSC7 separately; never query the range label as one sensor
Tie every value to its UBB controller and served segment before comparing limits
Retain complete IB/OOB SDR and Sensor List before filters and capture Web evidence
Do not switch rails, hot-plug controllers, alter load/fans/thresholds, reset BMC or clear logs
Use secret-safe authentication and redact retained evidence
Stop on population/segment mismatch, power anomaly, stale/invalid data, unsafe temperature or path disagreement; no automatic retry
agent_execution_scope: Verify exact row/variant, UBB HSC topology and same-target IB/OOB identity
Collect complete SDR and Sensor List plus eight exact mapped HSC records read-only
Compare entity, description, value, unit and state across paths
Prepare Web parity and passive power-segment/load/fan/ambient/SEL context
Perform no rail/load/cooling/threshold control or verdict
engineer_actions: Confirm Web entries and absent-position handling
Review eight-channel evidence and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Incomplete: the literal range is not an enumerated eight-record collection, only OOB and head-truncated SDR are proposed, and IB, full Sensor List, Web and safe credential handling are absent.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Resolve eight exact owner-mapped UBB HSC records and collect complete secret-safe IB/OOB SDR and Sensor List plus BMC Web and passive segment context.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: UBB HSC0–HSC7, all source views and 3/3-minute estimates remain; no active power-path stimulus is introduced.

modernized_recommendation.status: REQUIRES UBB HSC SEGMENT MAP, SENSOR SEMANTICS AND THERMAL LIMIT PACKAGE
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use an eight-row controller/segment/sensing-point matrix and a synchronized read-only capture from IB, OOB and Web under a documented load and cooling state.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds the power-segment association required to interpret controller heat and avoid cross-board name collisions.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: GB HSC and standby HSC evidence do not establish any UBB HSC0–HSC7 member.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A sensor can look nominal while the wrong segment is loaded, and board-probe lag can conceal a rapidly heating controller die.

project_override_considerations: Unpopulated segments require explicit N/A approval. Shared controllers or sensors need an owner-defined coverage relationship; duplicate readings are not proof of eight independent channels.
expected_evidence: Exact source identity/hash and unique-code result
UBB assembly plus eight-index controller, segment, load and physical-location map
Per-channel sensing source and SDR/entity/Sensor List/Web identity
Complete redacted IB/OOB SDR and Sensor List outputs
Eight readings/states with units, freshness, input/load/redundancy/cooling/ambient context and limits
BMC Web evidence plus passive rail/fan/SEL status
Same-target proof, exit status and artifact hashes
No rail/load/fan/write/log-clear audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, filters and Criteria all address UBB HSC0–HSC7 temperature. The absent segment mapping and SPEC values are project inputs rather than contradictory instructions.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The passive eight-channel verification is defined enough to classify; execution requires owner-controlled topology and criteria under ED-36.

review_improvement: Anchors UBB HSC temperatures to the actual controllers and power segments they protect, restores eight-member completeness and excludes neighboring GB and standby domains.
independent_technical_reasoning: HSC thermal behavior follows segment current and local airflow, so an index without its served load is not a meaningful acceptance identity. A valid comparison must preserve the simultaneous segment state and distinguish controller-die telemetry from slower board or ambient probes.
